candidates.title: Daily sales by product (till system)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source of daily units and revenue per product code; catalog states temporal_coverage start 2022-01-01, end null, daily refresh, last_refreshed 2026-10-14. Owner Retail Operations, steward Marco Bianchi.
candidates.found_via: search: daily sales by product ice cream; POS daily sales export gelato; then get_catalog_entry and wiki backlinks product_codes_2024, till_migration_2024
suspected_issues: Till system replaced 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10: no rows for those days (wiki till_migration_2024, last edited 2024-03-12). Must be treated as missing, not zero.
Product codes changed 2024-04-01; codes ending in 'L' replaced; no mapping table exists (wiki product_codes_2024, last edited 2024-04-02).
Catalog has no closed-day information; closed days may be absent rather than zero.
Classification confidential; access is by request to Retail Operations (warehouse_sql, request process).

candidates.title: Product list (current codes only)
candidates.why_relevant: Current product codes, names and categories; the only product master found. Could support name-based matching for N2 but lists only current codes. Owner Retail Operations, steward Marco Bianchi.
candidates.found_via: search: product code change 2024 mapping; legacy SKU to new SKU crosswalk; catalog entry sales.products
suspected_issues: Lists only current codes, so no pre-2024 codes (wiki product_codes_2024).
Last refreshed 2025-03-31 (catalog); a name-based match would be needed and names are not unique (wiki product_codes_2024).

candidates.title: Shop calendar (opening days, closures, local events)
candidates.why_relevant: Only internal source for shop open/closed status and local events per day; also needed to cross-check holiday flags (N4). Owner Store Operations, steward Elena Russo.
candidates.found_via: search: weather temperature daily shop location; shop opening hours calendar closed days; local events festival calendar; catalog entry store.calendar
suspected_issues: No wiki backlinks; no documentation of how closures or events were recorded.
Catalog row_count_approx about 1500, which is below the number of days across 2023-06 to 2026-03 plus 2022; daily completeness unverified.
Event coverage (which events, which dates) unknown; events may be recorded by announcement rather than occurrence date (unverified).
Weekly refresh; no history of opening-hour changes found.

candidates.title: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API (reanalysis archive)
candidates.why_relevant: Register source for daily maximum temperature. Must be queried with the assumed shop coordinates, timezone Europe/Rome, daily temperature_2m_max, and both windows.
suspected_issues: Register default_query uses Lisbon coordinates (38.72, -9.14), UTC, hourly temperature_2m, and a 2014-01-01..03 probe range; all must be overridden. Lisbon must not be used.
No source in the internal catalog or wiki names the shop's city; city and coordinates are an open assumption to record in decisions.md.
Reanalysis grid values (modelled), not a station reading.

candidates.title: Nager.Date public holidays API
candidates.why_relevant: Register source for national public holidays in IT for 2023 to 2026, to label each sales day.
suspected_issues: Endpoint takes country code (use IT); years 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026 must be queried.
Returns national holidays only; regional or patron-saint days need separate handling (not covered by this source).
Holidays on Sundays or closed days should be checked against shop calendar before counting as an effect.

unmet_needs: N2: No complete pre/post-2024 product code mapping exists in the catalog or wiki. Wiki product_codes_2024 (last edited 2024-04-02) states no mapping table exists and matching is by name only, with non-unique names. Like-for-like comparison may be possible only for products whose names are unique and unchanged; the owner of any mapping is not identified. A human could ask Retail Operations (steward Marco Bianchi) for a mapping or product master history.
N3 city: no source names the shop's city, so the Open-Meteo coordinates are an unresolved assumption the owner must confirm; decisions.md must record the choice.

N5 local events: no internal events source beyond the event_name column in store.calendar. No external municipal events calendar is in the register; policy.open_data_links allows only prototyping, benchmarking and context, and production needs Legal sign-off. A human would need to supply a link for the chosen city.
N4 regional/patron-saint holidays: not covered by Nager.Date; owner decision needed.
Daily sales completeness for 2024-02-05 to 2024-03-10 (till replacement gap) and whether closed days are absent or zero: stated only in the wiki, not verified in data.
